Content: Herbal supplements can interact with prescription drugs; for example St. John's wort can make some birth control and other medicines work less well. Always ask a doctor or pharmacist first.

Content: In the US, dietary supplements don't need FDA approval for safety or effectiveness before sale. Quality and strength can vary between products.
Source: Herbal Supplements: Quality and Safety Concerns

Content: Probiotics are live microbes found in some foods and supplements; effects depend on the specific strain. NCCIH warns they can be risky for premature infants and people with weak immune systems.
